title: comfy launch --json data payload
description: Emitted by `comfy launch --background` once ComfyUI has started successfully in the background. Foreground `comfy launch` blocks on the server and does not emit this envelope.

host.description: Host the background server bound to (e.g. `127.0.0.1`).

port.description: Port the background server is listening on.

pid.description: Process id of the launched background ComfyUI. Pass to `comfy stop` semantics via the recorded background entry.

background.description: Always true — this payload is only emitted for `--background` launches.
